value.rationale: Maximal repetitions/runs are a central, established string-algorithmic invariant. De Bruijn circles impose a rigid exact short-factor universe; the nontrivial distribution of longer minimal-period maximal repeats is not determined by their defining property or generic runs theorems. The six-cell complete census, sharp 12/13/14 run spectrum, exact frequencies and orbit decomposition constitute a natural full classification at the first 2048-cycle order, alongside structural explanations of fixed low periods. This is mathematically motivated finite information, not a routine reformulation of an existing table.
